title: Myo-Clear APP
subtitle: Myopic App Design using Lidar and Computer Vision

mainContent.content: A **UX / product** exploration for **myopia care**: combining **LiDAR** sensing and **computer vision** to make distance, posture, and screen habits legible — so the phone becomes a **calm coach** instead of another source of eye strain.

content.title: Myopia prevalence across countries and the impact of COVID-19 on children's screen time

mainContent.content: Myopia has become a major Chinese national health issue. **China's myopia rate is 61%** — among the highest globally. With the further spread of mobile devices and rising screen time, children's myopia is gradually increasing. The question is: how do we face this challenge?
"Unlocking human potential with universal eye health"

content.title: Research findings: mechanisms of myopia, field research data, user personas, and potential user pain points

mainContent.content: **Mechanism**: Tightening of ciliary muscles from close-proximity viewing creates pseudomyopia, which progresses to high myopia when unrelieved. Field research shows low intervention awareness (optometry only **2 times/year**) and low correction rates (**14.1%**). Children find existing apps too complex; parents dislike constant lecturing.

content.title: Concept proposals for parents, children, and society, plus technical testing of LiDAR-based distance measurement

mainContent.content: **For parents**: A dashboard that makes their child's vision health transparent and actionable. **For children**: Gentle nudges that build habits rather than lectures. **For society**: Leveraging mobile device prevalence for low-cost surveillance. Most devices already have front and rear cameras — ideal for computer vision distance measurement.

content.title: Service architecture: cloud data management, vision client, blur reminder, autonomous relaxation, and arranging function

mainContent.content: The service architecture connects: **Cloud data management** for centralized analytics, **Home Client** for daily monitoring, **Vision Client** for specialized tracking, **Blur Reminder** for non-intrusive close-distance alerts, **Autonomous Relaxation** with built-in break timers, and an **Arranging Function** dashboard for time allocation.

content.title: Delivery: mock views, wireframes, and storyboard showing interaction scenarios

mainContent.content: The app flows through contextual interactions: **Normal Page** runs silently at healthy distances. **Close Warning** gently alerts when too near. **Over Used** prompts breaks. **Tilt Warning** detects poor posture. **Comfort Exercise** guides quick eye relaxation. Wireframes show the myopia rate display and weekly usage trends.

content.title: Myo-Clear app interface: myopia rate dashboard with detailed usage tracking and weekly trend charts

mainContent.content: The main interface presents key metrics at a glance: **Myopia Rate** (90D to 110D scale), **Detailed Usage** (Heavy/Moderate/Mild), and **Weekly Trends**. Design prioritizes clarity over complexity — users see their vision health status without being overwhelmed by clinical terminology.

Core decisions: **From punishment to guidance** — children resist lectures, the app nudges. **From manual logging to ambient sensing** — LiDAR and camera detection runs automatically. **From clinical complexity to accessible insight** — the app translates data into visual feedback. **Balance precision with energy** — continuous LiDAR causes overheating, so the design intelligently samples.

Myo-Clear shows how **sensing technology** can address a **public health challenge** at scale. The key insight: myopia prevention isn't about more data — it's about **better signals**. The phone watches over your eyes so you don't have to watch over the phone.
